```{r}
#| label: gallery-stats
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

gallery_data <- read.csv("files/gallery_data.csv")
gallery_count <- nrow(gallery_data)
gallery_type_count <- length(unique(gallery_data$Type))
gallery_tutorial_count <- length(unique(sub("#.*$", "", gallery_data$Tutorial_url)))
```

👋 **Bizard** is a comprehensive repository of advanced visualization codes tailored for biomedical research. It currently includes `r format(gallery_count, big.mark = ",")` graphics across `r gallery_tutorial_count` tutorials (grouped under `r gallery_type_count` chart-type labels).

Browse the gallery below: use the search box and filters to find charts, click a chart image to zoom in for a preview, or click the blue title of a chart to open the corresponding graphic tutorial page.

```{r}
#| label: gallery-app-en
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

source("scripts/build_gallery.R")
cat(build_gallery_html("files/gallery_data.csv", "en"))
```
